title: Standard Treatment Workflow (STW) for Ante-Natal Management of Normal Pregnancy
issuer: ICMR / Department of Health Research, MoHFW, Government of India
version_note: Printed 'December 2025'; one-page workflow (ICD-11 QA42). Updated version of the 2019 workflow.
section: ICMR Standard Treatment Workflows, obstetrics and gynaecology
rights: All rights reserved by ICMR/DHR. Link only: do not copy the workflow text.
summary: A single-page flowchart for uncomplicated pregnancy. For each visit it sets out what to ask, examine, test and do, including essential and optional investigations, supplementation, Td immunisation, danger signals, birth preparedness and referral triggers.

title: Standard Treatment Workflow (STW): Postpartum Haemorrhage
issuer: ICMR / Department of Health Research, MoHFW, Government of India
version_note: Printed 'December 2025'; one-page workflow (ICD-11 JA43). Updated version of the 2019 workflow.
section: ICMR Standard Treatment Workflows, obstetrics and gynaecology
rights: All rights reserved by ICMR/DHR. Link only: do not copy the workflow text.
summary: A one-page algorithm for recognising and managing postpartum haemorrhage: red-flag signs and initial resuscitation, branching on placental delivery and on traumatic versus atonic bleeding, uterotonic options, escalation, and advice on referral and counselling.

title: Hypertensive Disorders in Pregnancy (HDP): Good Clinical Practice Recommendations 2019
version_note: 25-page PDF with 2019 on the cover. A newer edition may exist on fogsi.org (a 2026 third edition was reported in search but could not be opened), so confirm before relying on this edition.
rights: No reuse statement found in the document. Link only.
summary: Recommendations for Indian practice on classifying hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and predicting pre-eclampsia, including a clinical gestosis score and newer screening tests, plus maternal alerts, diagnosis, medical management, timing of delivery, corticosteroids, eclampsia care and postpartum management.

title: Induction of Labour: Good Clinical Practice Recommendations
version_note: 92-page PDF; 2018 printed in the front matter.
rights: No reuse statement found in the document. Link only.
summary: Evidence-based recommendations on when and how to induce labour in the Indian setting: indications and timing, cervical assessment, and a comparison of prostaglandins, misoprostol, oxytocin and mechanical methods, with appendices on definitions, FIGO misoprostol-only regimens, a patient information and consent sheet, and a checklist.

title: Guidelines for Antenatal Care and Skilled Attendance at Birth by ANMs/LHVs/SNs
issuer: Maternal Health Division, MoHFW, Government of India
topic: Antenatal care and skilled birth attendance
version_note: 140 pages; 'April 2010' on the cover; second edition revising the 2005 guideline.
rights: No reuse statement found in the document. Link only.
summary: Training-oriented national guidelines for ANMs, LHVs and staff nurses on antenatal care and attending births, with basic management of pregnancy and childbirth complications, postpartum care and essential newborn care and resuscitation.

title: Diagnosis & Management of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: Technical and Operational Guidelines
issuer: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India (NHM, Maternal Health)
version_note: 100 pages; no date printed on the cover. The PDF was created in February 2018. Replaces the December 2014 national GDM guideline in practice.
rights: The document states that any part may be reproduced and excerpts quoted without permission, provided the material is distributed free of cost and the source is acknowledged.
summary: Combined technical and programme guidance for detecting and managing gestational diabetes in public facilities: operational definition, testing, medical nutrition therapy and management protocol, then rollout, records and registers, monitoring and budgeting, with annexures of BMI charts, sample diet plans and reporting formats.

title: Guidance Note on Prevention and Management of Postpartum Haemorrhage
issuer: Maternal Health Division, MoHFW, Government of India
rights: No reuse statement found in the document. Link only.
summary: Explains why postpartum haemorrhage is a leading cause of maternal death in India, its definition and causes, prevention (active management of the third stage, birth preparedness) and facility-level management including shock care and referral.

title: Guidance Note on Use of Uterotonics during labour
issuer: Maternal Health Division, MoHFW, Government of India

summary: Defines which uterotonics may be used at which level of facility and for what purpose: third-stage management, treatment of postpartum haemorrhage, and the limited indications for induction or augmentation, with cautions against unnecessary use.
